findings.title: Possible version mismatch in repair limits check
findings.message: The validation check compares 'repair.Limits' against 'ot.DefaultElectricalRepairLimitsV22()', despite the schema being explicitly checked as 'kicadai.electrical-repair.v23'. This may cause validation failures if the specification limits were updated for v23.
findings.suggestion: Verify if 'ot.DefaultElectricalRepairLimitsV23()' should be used instead of 'V22'.

findings.title: Combined validation checks obscure failure reasons
findings.message: Multiple distinct fields (identity hash, schema, requirement hash, limits, and policy IDs) are checked in a single conditional block. If the test fails, the generic error message does not specify which condition was violated, making debugging difficult.
findings.suggestion: Split the validation into individual checks with specific error messages for each field.
